labels.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE for source-backed rat serum and tissue concentration-time inputs only. Body values establish group summaries at three sampling times, with serum <LLOQ at 24 h. DR001 has PMB identity and a source locator; DR002 has summary definitions, time-specific counts and explicitly different terminal-sampling groups. DR003 has distinct serum and homogenate matrices and units, but total/unbound basis and conversion or bridge support remain UNRESOLVED. DR006 and DR007 have candidate systemic and lung-homogenate inputs, while intended model outputs, input timing details and design-supported prediction opportunities remain UNRESOLVED. DR013 has a study-associated weight range and rat curve coverage, without qualified parameters or individual weights. DR039 has reported concentration SD and sampling context, but no verified individual PK variability inputs. These SD values do not establish animal random effects, longitudinal individual trajectories, PTA variability or human predictive validity.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A21 identifies PMB sulfate (USP), serum µg/mL and tissue µg/g homogenate, but explicitly leaves salt/base dose basis unstated. Total versus unbound concentration basis and conversion or physiological-bridge inputs are NOT_FOUND. Serum and lung homogenate cannot be treated as interchangeable plasma, BAL or ELF quantities.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported dose and assay-analyte definitions, total/unbound basis, and evidence for any proposed matrix conversion or physiological bridge. Retain separate matrices and original units pending review.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:B26 contains <LLOQ and A22 states <LLOQ retained.; the numerical LLOQ and applicable assay definition are NOT_FOUND in this item.
findings.needed_material: Applicable serum assay LLOQ with units and scope. Preserve <LLOQ unchanged while the limit remains unresolved.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A21 supplies single IV 3 mg/kg via jugular cannula, and A24:A26 supply 3, 6 and 24 h. Bolus versus infusion, input duration, dosing-time reference, explicit sampling-time origin and actual versus nominal timing are NOT_FOUND. The available summaries and terminal-group counts remain candidate inputs.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported administration input history and sampling-time definitions before dependent animal PK model design; do not infer IV bolus from the cannula description.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2 provides serum and seven tissue-homogenate summaries at three terminal-sampling times. It does not define requested model outputs, establish a supported pulmonary bridge, identify held-out prediction opportunities or demonstrate fit, identifiability or predictive validity.
findings.needed_material: An endpoint-specific animal PK input assessment retaining the distinct matrices, group-summary level and sampling design. Resolve intended outputs and design-supported evaluation opportunities in the animal PK module.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A22 reports Female Sprague-Dawley rats 225–250 g. This is a study-associated range, not individual body weights. Health or infection state, qualified parameter outputs and approach-specific correction inputs are NOT_FOUND in this item.
findings.needed_material: Retain this rat curve and weight-range evidence with its source status. Before translation, establish the study-specific weight information required by the considered approach, animal health or infection state, and compatible parameter or curve definitions.

findings.reason: MI019, Supported PK variability for PTA, remains status DEFERRED, needed_at clinical, resolution_status OPEN, originating from main:/missing_information/items/18. Its impact remains: The variability basis for PTA simulation remains unqualified. Under DR039, F0003:S2:T2:A21 reports Summary mean ± SD and A22 explicitly describes different terminal-sampling groups. These summaries do not provide verified individual PK trajectories, parameter variability, uncertainty distributions or correlations; the requested PTA uncertainty components are not established by this item.
findings.needed_material: Assess which PK variability is defensible for PTA and specify its use under SC031 and SC038 before simulation. Preserve the downstream assessment of parameter, binding, PD-target and MIC uncertainty and evidence-supported dependencies. Carry MI019 unchanged to clinical; do not derive individual variability from these group summaries.
